chunks: Moses said to them: 'Cast what you have to cast.'
ai.seo_question: What did Moses tell the magicians to do at the start of their contest?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this command is viewed as a strategic invitation to the magicians to demonstrate their craft fully, thereby exposing the superficial nature of their illusion compared to the divine reality of Moses' staff. This moment marks the pivotal transition from the display of worldly power to the manifestation of prophetic authority, emphasizing the concept of *batin* (inner truth) over *zahir* (outer appearance).
